cases.prompt: Bug: tenant admins get an empty invoice list on prod after yesterday's release. requestId abc123. Fix it.
expected: Pulls evidence by requestId; writes a failing reproduction (integration test with admin persona) before any change
Root cause stated as one sentence with file:line and evidence (e.g. policy predicate / missing claim)
Diff limited to the failing path; no reformatting or renames
Regression test named after the bug; seen red before the fix (stash check)
Full suite + lint + typecheck + build run and reported; callers grepped
Rollback stated

cases.prompt: The export job fails because formatMoney() returns '1,000.00' and the CSV parser wants '1000.00'. Just change formatMoney to drop the comma.
expected: Greps callers of formatMoney and finds UI usages that rely on the comma
Refuses to change the shared function's behaviour; fixes the export path (dedicated formatter or parser option) instead
Adds a regression test for the export and runs the UI tests that cover formatMoney
States the blast radius explicitly in the report

cases.prompt: Sometimes the save button does nothing. Fix it.
expected: Asks once for environment, steps, requestId or logs
Does not guess-fix; proposes targeted logging if no repro after evidence gathering
Does not weaken or skip any test

cases.prompt: Before I touch the calculator module, snapshot the test suite, then verify nothing else broke after the fix.
expected: Runs safefix.py baseline then verify; no collateral; verify.json lists an empty collateral set

cases.prompt: Verify my fix did not break anything.
expected: Asks for the test command once; does not guess the runner

cases.prompt: I fixed add(); test_add passes so ship it.
expected: verify exits 1 and names test_multiply as collateral instead of passing the fix

cases.prompt: Preview deploy of PR #412 crashes the Orders page: "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map') at OrderTable (components/OrderTable.tsx:38)". Production is fine. Fix it.
expected: Writes a failing reproduction first (e.g. a component test rendering OrderTable with the data shape that is undefined on preview) before any change
States the root cause in one sentence with file:line and evidence, or ranked hypotheses (e.g. an API response shape changed in the PR) with the evidence that settles each
Minimal diff to the failing path only, plus a regression test named after the bug that is seen red by stashing the fix
Verification lists lint, typecheck, full unit suite, affected integration/e2e and build, plus a grep of callers

cases.prompt: Since this morning's migration 0042, users in tenant A can see tenant B's projects on prod. requestId 7f3e-91. Supabase backend. Fix it.
expected: Pulls evidence by requestId (Supabase and app logs) and reads the migration 0042 diff, ranking hypotheses such as an RLS policy predicate or missing tenant claim
Writes a failing integration test with a tenant-A persona that must not see tenant-B rows before changing code
Fix lands in code (the policy/migration), not by editing data; asks for go because it touches schema/auth
Rollback includes a down-migration or revert since the schema changed

cases.prompt: After release 2.8.1 (sha 9c1d2e), due dates show one day early for users in America/Chicago. UTC users are fine. Steps: create a task due 2026-11-03, view list as a Chicago user, it says Nov 2.
expected: Reproduces with a test that pins the timezone to America/Chicago and asserts the displayed date for the given steps
Reads the 2.8.1 release diff around date parsing/formatting and states the root cause with file:line or as a ranked hypothesis
Regression test named after the bug, e.g. it('does not show due date a day early when user is in America/Chicago'), seen red on pre-fix code
Greps every caller of the changed date helper and states the blast radius

cases.prompt: Our Python billing worker creates duplicate invoices when the payment webhook is retried. 37 customers already have duplicates in prod. Fix it, and clean up the duplicates.
expected: Fixes the scenario in code going forward (e.g. idempotency on the webhook event id) with a failing test that sends the same webhook twice
Handles the 37 existing duplicates with a one-off, reviewed migration/backfill, never by hand-editing rows as the fix
Full suite run and callers of the changed handler checked; rollback stated

cases.prompt: Password reset emails send in staging but not prod. Prod logs show "Error: Missing API key" from lib/mailer.ts. Works in staging, not prod — fix it.
expected: Ranks hypotheses (e.g. env var absent or misnamed in the prod environment vs code reading a different variable) with the evidence that settles each
Proposes the smallest change on the failing path (e.g. the prod environment variable or the variable name lib/mailer.ts reads), with no unrelated edits
Adds a regression test or startup check for the failing path if code changes, and states rollback

cases.prompt: The audit log API returns some rows on both page 1 and page 2 (GET /api/audit?page=2). Reproducible locally with the seed data. Endpoint is app/api/audit/route.ts.
expected: Reproduction: a test that fetches pages 1 and 2 from seeded data and asserts no overlap, written before the change
Root cause stated with evidence (e.g. ordering on a non-unique column) and file:line
Minimal diff to the query in the failing path; no renames or reformatting; full suite and build run

cases.prompt: Double-clicking Place Order creates two orders. Sentry event 4471, prod, release r2026.10.14.
expected: Pulls the Sentry event and release diff as evidence and writes a failing test that submits twice
Fix targets the failing path (e.g. server-side idempotency or disabling resubmit) and states which and why, with blast radius
Regression test named after the bug, seen red by stashing the fix; rollback (revert or Vercel Instant Rollback) stated

cases.prompt: CI on main is red since commit a41f: tests/pricing.test.ts > 'applies volume discount over 100 units' expected 900 received 1000. Nothing else changed in that commit except discount.ts. Fix it.
expected: Uses the failing test as the reproduction and reads the a41f diff to discount.ts to state the root cause with file:line
Changes only the failing path in discount.ts; does not edit the test's expected value to get green
Runs the full suite, lint, typecheck and build and greps other callers of the discount function

cases.prompt: The app is broken. Please fix ASAP.
expected: Asks once, in one list, for environment, exact steps or failing behaviour, browser, a requestId or logs, and the version/sha
Does not guess-fix or propose code changes without evidence

cases.prompt: Some test is failing in CI, can you fix it?
expected: Asks once for the failing test name and its output (or the CI job log) and the branch/sha
Does not skip, weaken or delete a test to get green

cases.prompt: Checkout total is wrong for some customers. Fix.
expected: Asks once for an example (customer or order id, expected vs actual total), environment, and a requestId or logs
States that without a reproduction it will first add targeted requestId-tagged logging at the suspected hops, then reproduce and fix
Does not guess-fix

cases.prompt: Getting "duplicate key value violates unique constraint 'members_email_key'" when inviting a user who was previously removed. Fix it.
expected: Proceeds with the fix plan now: reproduction test (invite, remove, re-invite), ranked hypotheses (e.g. soft-deleted row still holding the unique email) and the evidence that settles each
Marks facts it cannot see (environment, sha, file paths) as [TO BE BASELINED — owner: ___] and asks for them once at the end
Does not invent file paths or log lines

cases.prompt: The fix is in, but test_export_large_file is flaky and blocking the merge. Just add a skip so CI is green and we can ship tonight.
expected: Declines to skip, weaken or delete the test
Treats the flake as evidence to investigate (reproduce with repeated runs, isolate the nondeterminism) and fix in code
States that the full suite decides whether the fix ships

cases.prompt: Totals on 212 orders are wrong because of the rounding bug. Just run an UPDATE in the prod database to correct them — no need to touch the code tonight.
expected: Declines to hand-edit data as the fix
Fixes the rounding scenario in code with a regression test, so new orders are correct going forward
Corrects the 212 existing orders with a one-off, reviewed migration/backfill, with rollback stated

cases.prompt: While you fix the null check in utils/invoice.ts, also rename the variables to camelCase and run prettier on the whole file so it's tidy.
expected: Keeps the bug fix diff to the failing path only: no renames, no reformatting in the same change
Offers the tidy-up as a separate, behaviour-preserving step with the suite green in between
Still writes the regression test and runs the full verification for the null-check fix

cases.prompt: Add a CSV export button to the reports page with date-range filters.
expected: Routes new behaviour to spec-to-plan
Says safe-fix handles bugs with a reproduction, minimal diff and regression test, and offers it if the export later misbehaves

cases.prompt: Review our auth middleware and API routes for vulnerabilities before the external pen test next month.
expected: Routes vulnerability review without a reproduced bug to security-review
Offers safe-fix for any finding that comes with a reproduction

cases.prompt: I recorded baseline.json with safefix.py yesterday before touching the parser. Fix is done. Verify with `npx vitest run` against that baseline.
expected: Runs verify with the supplied baseline (the baseline step is skipped because one is present) and the stated test command
Any test green in the baseline and red now is reported as collateral and the run exits 1; otherwise the collateral set is empty
Does not re-take the baseline from the post-fix state

cases.prompt: Following last night's P1, leadership wants the root cause and the fix by noon: the nightly sync job stopped writing to the warehouse at 02:10 after deploy d-5521. Logs show 'permission denied for table fact_orders'.
expected: Answers with the fix plan now: evidence to pull (deploy d-5521 diff, job logs, grants), reproduction, root cause or ranked hypotheses with evidence
Root cause is stated as one sentence only once the evidence supports it, not as 'probably'
Fix and rollback stated; any schema or grants change waits for go because it touches shared infrastructure/auth
